description: Hydrogen in Australian natural gas: occurrences, sources and resources is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. Natural or native molecular hydrogen (H2) can be a major component in natural gas, and yet its role in the global energy sector’s usage as a clean energy carrier is not normally considered. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are Amadeus Basin, Bass Basin, Bonaparte Basin, Bowen-Surat basins, Browse Basin. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2026-01-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
